vn.t: Marcus Today at 9:12 PM Okay so I finally finished the boss fight on hard mode and I have a lot of thoughts about it.

Second, the music is incredible. I would play the fight again just to hear the choir come in at the final phase, and I think more games should do this kind of thing.

doc.t: Early systems relied on hand-crafted features and template matching, which limited them to a small number of fonts. Neural approaches replaced these features with learned representations and now reach human accuracy on clean print.

However, text in games and video differs from print in several ways: fonts are stylized, backgrounds are noisy, and lines are often very short. These properties motivate the layout-aware grouping we propose in Chapter 4.
Neural machine translation translates whole sentences, so the quality of a translation depends on whether a sentence reaches the model intact.
